title: SpaceX Launches Starship: 1st Post-IPO Test Flight Succeeds
excerpt: SpaceX successfully launched its Starship rocket for the first time since its June 2026 IPO, demonstrating full reusability and a 100-ton payload capacity to low Earth orbit.
description: SpaceX launched its Starship rocket on its first post-IPO test flight, achieving full reusability and a 100-ton payload to LEO in a 90-minute mission.
